pokedexEntries.su: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

pokedexEntries.mo: Although it’s too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet’s sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

pokedexEntries.us: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it’s not intelligent enough to care.

pokedexEntries.um: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It’s usually a fruitless attempt.

pokedexEntries.sw: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sh: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

pokedexEntries.sc: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

pokedexEntries.vi: A Greedent drawn in by the sweet scent of these Pokémon will tuck the Bounsweet in among the berries in its tail and carry them all away.
